title: Device configuration
loadError: Device configuration could not be loaded.
requestHint: The server saves the request and waits for the device. You can leave this page or refresh it while the read continues.
targetHint: Uses the device linked to this truck in Karma.
reconciling: Checking whether the request was saved. Refresh saved results before submitting again.
requestError: The read request could not be saved. Refresh saved results before trying again.
requestAccepted: The read request was saved. The server is waiting for the device.
disabled: Background device reads are disabled on the server. Previously saved requests and results remain available.
pending: An operation is already in progress. The server continues its saved background task.
pollError: Saved results could not be refreshed. The background operation continues on the server.
historyHint: The 20 most recent requests for this device in the current fleet are shown. Times describe saved results.
historicalSnapshotHint: You are viewing an older saved configuration. Show the latest confirmed settings before editing an interval.
resultHint: These settings were observed from the selected device during this read window. Later changes outside holita may not be reflected here.
noSnapshot: No complete configuration has been confirmed yet.
emptySnapshot: The device returned a complete empty parameter configuration.
unknownParameters: Original parameter IDs and complete definitions are preserved, including parameters unknown to the local catalog. An interval of zero is shown as returned by the device.

statuses.TIMED_OUT: No complete response before the deadline

editor.title: Change eData parameters
editor.hint: Choose a parameter and interval. A fresh device readback will verify the change.
editor.editHint: Set a new interval for this parameter. A fresh device readback will verify the change.
editor.disabled: Parameter changes are disabled on the server. Saved operations remain available.
editor.chooseTarget: Select a device before preparing a change.
editor.baselineRequired: Read this device’s current parameters first.
editor.stale: The device or its saved settings changed. Close this change and prepare it again from the latest read.
editor.noPresets: No additional eligible catalog presets are available for this saved configuration.
editor.parameterPlaceholder: Select a parameter from the baseline
editor.preserveHint: Unknown parameter IDs can be edited too. The server preserves the complete original definition and changes only its reporting interval.
editor.intervalHint: Use a preset or enter whole seconds (0–65000). Zero means “Not in use” and needs separate confirmation.
editor.unchanged: Enter an interval different from the saved value.
editor.verificationHint: Other parameters are preserved. Confirmation appears after a matching device readback.
editor.zeroHint: Monitor describes interval 0 as not in use. Readback verifies the stored configuration; it does not prove whether the device has stopped reporting measurements.
editor.zeroRequired: Confirm the special meaning of interval zero.
editor.confirmation: I confirm the change shown for this truck.
editor.confirmationRequired: Confirm the current target, baseline and requested change.
editor.accepted: The parameter change was saved. The server will check, send and verify it in the background.
editor.requestError: The parameter change could not be confirmed as saved. Check refreshed saved operations before submitting again.

writeUncertain: The device may have received this change. The server checks readback and does not automatically resend an uncertain write.
writeVerifiedAfterUncertainty: The write response was uncertain. A subsequent complete readback verified the intended configuration.

errors.noConfiguration: The device finished its response without returning a configuration. No new settings were confirmed.
errors.generic: The request has no confirmed complete result. Start another read after checking its saved state.

ruleEditor.title: Review and send rule
ruleEditor.hint: Only this rule is sent. Confirmation requires a fresh device readback; a queued request is not yet an applied change.
ruleEditor.baselineRequired: Read this device’s periodic data and rules first. Wait for any pending or uncertain operation to finish.
ruleEditor.stale: The target or baseline changed. Close this review and prepare it again.
ruleEditor.duplicate: Multiple local drafts use this rule ID. Resolve the duplicate before sending.
ruleEditor.missing: Parameters missing from the confirmed device configuration:
ruleEditor.name: Rule name
ruleEditor.zero: I confirm that transitions marked “Do not report an event” remain unreported.
ruleEditor.confirm: I confirm the rule and change shown for this truck.

changeAccepted: The change was saved. The server will check, send and verify it in the background.
noRulesSnapshot: No complete rule configuration has been confirmed yet. Local drafts are available below.
